title: Lithium vs Lead-Acid E-Rickshaw Battery: 3-Year Cost in Rupees | Revolt Lithium
desc: Real 3-year cost of a lithium (LiFePO4) vs lead-acid e-rickshaw battery: replacements, electricity, upkeep and weight, worked out in rupees.
h1: Lithium vs lead-acid e-rickshaw battery: the 3-year cost
summary: Batteries, electricity and upkeep added up in rupees for a driver running 90 km a day.
html:
A lithium pack costs more on the first day. The question every driver asks is whether it pays back. Here is the full 3-year sum for a typical e-rickshaw in western Uttar Pradesh, using the same numbers as our savings calculator.

The assumptions

  • 90 km a day, 26 working days a month
  • Electricity at ₹7.5 per unit
  • A 4 × 12V lead-acid set at ₹30,000 that lasts about 12 months in daily use
  • A 51.2V 105Ah LiFePO4 pack at an example price of ₹62,000 (ask us for today's price)
  • About 50 Wh per km. Lithium charges at about 95% efficiency, lead-acid at about 75%, and the 120 kg lead-acid set adds roughly 8% to energy use.

The 3-year total

Cost over 36 monthsLead-acidLithium
Batteries₹90,000 (3 sets)₹62,000 (1 pack)
Charging electricity₹45,490₹33,253
Water top-up and upkeep₹7,200₹0
Total₹1,42,690₹95,253

At these numbers lithium saves about ₹47,000 in three years, roughly ₹1,300 a month. The pack is also under warranty for the full 36 months, while a lead-acid set is usually covered for 6 to 12 months.

What the table does not show

The lithium pack weighs 44 kg against about 120 kg for lead-acid. Less weight means easier climbs, less wear on tyres and suspension, and more room for passengers. It charges in 4 to 5 hours instead of 8 to 10, so a driver can top up at lunch. There is no acid to spill and no lead to scrap.

Your numbers will differ. Enter your own daily kilometres, electricity rate and the quotation you received in the calculator. If you run fewer than 40 km a day, the saving is smaller; above 100 km it grows quickly.

Which pack to choose

Both the Redtuff RT-5.376KWH and the Livgreen 51.2V 105Ah use the same 16S1P prismatic LFP cells, BMS and warranty. Choose the brand your area knows.
faq: Is a lithium e-rickshaw battery worth it?
For daily use above about 50 km, yes. At 90 km a day the 3-year saving is around ₹47,000 compared with lead-acid, before counting the lower weight and faster charging.
Do I need a new charger for lithium?
Yes, use a lithium-compatible charger set for the 51.2V LFP pack. Our team checks your charger and controller before fitting.

title: Which E-Scooter Battery Voltage Do I Need? 48V vs 60V vs 72V | Revolt Lithium
desc: How to pick the right lithium battery for your electric scooter: find your system voltage, choose capacity for range, and check connector and charger.
h1: Which battery does my electric scooter need? 48V, 60V or 72V
summary: Find your scooter's voltage, pick capacity for range, and avoid the one mistake that damages controllers.
html:
Electric scooters in India run on 48V, 60V or 72V systems. The battery must match that voltage exactly. Capacity (Ah) is then your choice, and it decides the range.

Step 1: find your scooter's voltage

Look at the label on the controller or the old battery, or check the output written on your charger. A 60V scooter will say 60V on at least one of them. If you can't find it, send a photo of the controller label on WhatsApp to 97560 73477 and we will tell you.

Never fit a higher voltage than the controller is rated for. A 72V pack on a 60V controller can burn the controller and motor. A lower voltage will work but the scooter will be slow.

Step 2: choose capacity for range

BatteryEnergyApprox. range
Livgreen LG-4830, 48V 30Ah1.44 kWh≈45 km
Livgreen LG-6030 / Redtuff RT-6030, 60V 30Ah1.8 kWh≈60 km
Livgreen LG 6032, 60V 32Ah1.92 kWh≈60 km
Livgreen LG-7230, 72V 30Ah2.16 kWh≈70 km

Range assumes about 28 Wh per km on a level road with one rider. A pillion, hills or low tyre pressure can cut it by a fifth or more.

Step 3: check connector and charger

Our scooter packs come with an Anderson-type connector, the grey plug most Indian e-scooters use. Use a charger made for LiFePO4 at your pack's voltage; an old lead-acid charger can overcharge lithium cells. Revolt RLES packs add a Bluetooth BMS so you can see every cell's voltage on your phone.
faq: Can I put a 72V battery in a 60V scooter?
No. Only fit the voltage your controller is rated for. A higher voltage can damage the controller and motor.
How long does an e-scooter lithium battery last?
LiFePO4 cells are built for years of daily charging, and our scooter packs carry a 36-month warranty.

title: Lithium Inverter Battery Backup: How Many Hours Will I Get? | Revolt Lithium
desc: Work out backup hours for a lithium (LiFePO4) inverter battery: simple formula, a backup table for 1.344, 2.688 and 5.040 kWh, and which voltage fits your inverter.
h1: Lithium inverter battery backup: how many hours will I get?
summary: A simple formula, a backup table for every model and which voltage fits your inverter.
html:
Backup depends on two things: how much energy the battery stores, and how many watts you run during a power cut. Here is how to work it out in a minute.

The formula

Backup hours = battery kWh × 1000 × 0.9 × 0.92 ÷ load in watts. The 0.9 keeps 10% in reserve to protect the cells, and 0.92 is a typical inverter's efficiency. Our backup calculator does this for you.

Backup table

Battery300 W500 W1000 W
1.344 kWh (12.8V)3.7 hr2.2 hr1.1 hr
2.688 kWh (25.6V)7.4 hr4.5 hr2.2 hr
5.040 kWh (48V)13.9 hr8.3 hr4.2 hr

What is 500 W in a home?

A ceiling fan uses about 75 W, an LED tube about 18 W, a TV 60 to 100 W, and a fridge about 150 W while its compressor runs. Five fans, six LED lights and a TV come to roughly 500 W.

Match the voltage to your inverter

  • 12V inverter (up to about 900 VA): 12.8V 1.344 kWh
  • 24V inverter (about 1.5 to 2 kVA): 25.6V 2.688 kWh, Redtuff or Livgreen
  • 48V inverter or solar hybrid (about 3 to 5 kVA): 48V 5.040 kWh, Redtuff or Livgreen
Lithium vs tubular: no acid, no water top-up, no fumes indoors, faster recharge after the power returns, and a 60-month warranty.
faq: Can I use a lithium battery with my old inverter?
Yes, if the system voltage matches (12V, 24V or 48V). Set the inverter to a lithium or suitable charging profile; we can help on call.
How long does a lithium inverter battery last?
LiFePO4 is built for thousands of cycles, and our inverter batteries carry a 60-month warranty.
